rows.grounds: Compound adjective describing something located in the collection of syllables on the forehead.
Numerical quantity indicating the number of repetitions.
Gerund expressing the completion of the action.
Vocative address to a deity honored by the gods.

items.question: What ritual repetition involving the forehead syllable-mass is enjoined for the god-worshipped?
premises: The action is directed toward what is situated in the forehead syllable-mass.
The prescribed quantity of the action is one hundred thousand.
The addressee is the one worshipped by the gods.
items.inference: One must perform a hundred-thousandfold repetition focused on what is situated in the forehead syllable-mass, O god-worshipped.
uncertainties: The exact nature of the action implied by kṛtya (such as recitation or visualization) is not explicitly specified.
items.plain_english: O god-worshipped one, having performed a hundred thousand repetitions focused on what is situated in the mass of syllables on the forehead.
